t: You are on Upper Thames Street, where All-Hallows-the-Great once stood. The church is first mentioned in 1235. The Great Fire of London destroyed it in 1666, and the office of Sir Christopher Wren rebuilt it. Wren is named as its designer. He is the architect of St Paul's Cathedral. The church was demolished in 1894. Many bodies were then disinterred from its churchyard and reburied at Brookwood Cemetery.
